name: Watch list
title: Watch list: the films and shows you want to watch, are watching and have watched, with tonight's pick

permissions: keeps the person's watch list of films and shows: each title's details, their progress through a show's seasons and episodes, their own rating, notes and who recommended it
looks a title up by its words or its IMDb number in public sources with no account: IMDb's search suggestions, TVmaze, Wikidata and Wikipedia; nothing about the person is sent
downloads each title's poster once into the data directory and serves it from Rouh's own address
adds, marks, ticks, rates, notes and moves titles when the person asks in a chat or by voice (watch_list), and takes one off only on their own words

shares a list with a person by email through Rouh's own sharing (the same permission record as a shared page, opened with a rouh.land sign-in): they see and keep that one list at /shared/<token>, never anything else; the invite letter goes only when the owner ticks it
accounts: IMDb search suggestions, TVmaze, Wikidata and Wikipedia (public, no account)
touches.remove: Delete this manifest, rouh/watchlist.py, rouh/web/watchlist.py and its routes in rouh/project/urls.py, rouh/models/watchlist.py, watchlistpage.js, watchlistpage.css, watchshared.js and rouh/templates/rouh/watch_shared.html, the watch-list branch of guests.reader_view and sharing._read_at, the /shared/<token>/watch routes, the watchView layer in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, its side in app/runs.js, app/address.js, app/cards.js and app/socket.js, the watchlist message in protocol.d.ts and PROTOCOL.md, addressing.WATCH, watch_list in tools.py, toolsearch.py, toolsides.py, incognito.py and job_policy.py, rouh/testing/fake_watch.py and ROUH_WATCH_LOOKUP in tests/e2e/conftest.py; drop the tables watch_marks, watch_lists and watch_items, and the page_guests rows whose rel starts _watch/, with a migration and the posters in the data directory's watchlist folder.
